overall_assessment: USN extraction is mostly correct: course content, learning outcomes (all sub-groups), prerequisites and the assessment/coursework split are right in the large majority of the 16 plans, and most pre-pass flags (leak->X, blob, empty, short) are false alarms. Real defects are concentrated in long practice (nursing) plans where arbeidskrav, attendance rules and skikkethet text end up in the wrong section, plus a placeholder reading_list row and catalogue-header noise in reading lists.

findings.evidence: The reading list is not published yet.
findings.description: The site's placeholder for an unpublished literature list is emitted as a reading_list row (5 of 16 courses: also MAKM219 and MM-MAC5080 2019). It is not a reading list and will count as a present section in analyses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Literature section is captured verbatim; .clean_sections() has no rule for the placeholder sentence.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R) drop a reading_list whose whole text matches '^The reading list is not published yet\.?$' (and the Norwegian equivalent) so no row is emitted.

findings.evidence: Kunnskapsdepartementet fastsatte 30. juni 2006 Forskrift om skikkethetsvurdering i høyere utdanning.
findings.description: Under the heading Deltakelse/Obligatoriske arbeidskrav the page carries a generic fitness-to-practise (skikkethetsvurdering) notice with the criteria a-h. This is regulatory boilerplate identical across nursing plans, not a coursework requirement, and makes up a large part of the section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Text after the last Arbeidskrav item continues the same section; no boilerplate rule for the skikkethet paragraph.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a cleanup (.drop or boilerplate regex) in .clean_sections() removing the block starting at a line '^Skikkethetsvurdering' through the criteria list (a-h) in coursework_requirements.

findings.description: In the practice-course plan the descriptions of Arbeidskrav 2 and 3 (purpose, frames, criteria, pass/approve gates) sit in assessment while Arbeidskrav 1 and the short Arbeidskrav 2/3 consequence lines are in coursework_requirements, so the same pass/fail gates are split across two sections. Per the codebook, arbeidskrav belong in coursework_requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The page has no separate heading before the later Arbeidskrav blocks (they sit under Vurderingsformer), and the text fallback cuts only on section headings, so the arbeidskrav text stays with assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a line-start rule in sectionize()/.clean_sections() that moves paragraphs starting '^Arbeidskrav \d' (to the next non-arbeidskrav heading) into coursework_requirements, or treat 'Arbeidskrav N' as a coursework heading in R/section_heading_map.R.

findings.evidence: Kliniske studier vurderes til bestått/ikke beståtte
findings.description: teaching_methods (4726 chars) contains, after the learning activities, the full Praksis block: compulsory attendance and absence rules, turnus, mid/final assessment and the 'Varsel om ikke bestått' procedure. This is assessment and coursework-requirement content, not teaching methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Praksis heading (listed in the table of contents) is not recognised by the text fallback, so its text is appended to the preceding Læringsaktiviteter section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map the USN heading '^Praksis$' in R/section_heading_map.R and split its paragraphs: attendance/absence to coursework_requirements, 'vurderes til bestått' / 'Varsel om ikke bestått' to assessment.

findings.evidence: Aktuelle praksisplasser er kirurgiske døgnavdelinger, dagavdelinger og poliklinikker, akuttavdelinger og rehabiliteringsavdelinger.Kliniske studier er veiledet, se under læringsaktiviteter.
findings.description: The Praksis paragraph repeats the opening of Faglig innhold already extracted into course_content, so the same text occurs in two sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Same unrecognised Praksis heading; the practice block itself restates the course content.
findings.suggested_fix: Handle together with the Praksis heading fix; optionally dedupe paragraphs in teaching_methods identical to course_content in .clean_sections().

findings.description: Reading lists begin with the library catalogue header (course title, code and campus, sometimes 'Samling 1: Dag 1, Dag 2' or 'In compendium' labels per item), which is navigation/metadata, not references.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Literature block is taken verbatim from the reading-list widget; no cleanup of the header line and per-item labels.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the first line matching '^.+ \([A-Z0-9-]+\) [A-ZÆØÅ][a-zæøå]+$' and lines equal to 'In compendium' in reading_list cleanup.
